rebuttals.argument: While Dutch Bros has implemented targeted local offers and additional peak labor with the intent to attract new demand, the actual capacity to effectively "serve redirected mobile demand" is unmeasured. Our dossier explicitly states that "queue capacity... are unknown and must be estimated or measured before scaling" (d.dutch.d6). Therefore, the claim that our implementation ensures we will 'serve redirected mobile demand' is not fully supported without knowledge of our actual capacity limits.
